methodologyNotes: Roster covers 11 current and recently discontinued self-leveling laser levels spanning cross-line, multi-plane, point, and rotary categories in red and green beam. Specs re-verified against manufacturer product pages (Bosch, DeWalt, Klein Tools, Huepar, Skil, Topcon, Leica Geosystems, Johnson Level, Spectra Precision), official press releases, ManualsLib manuals, and authorized resellers (Global Test Supply, Geo Networking, Haus of Tools, Ohio Power Tool). Prices are the most recently observed US retail selling price or stated MSRP in USD. accuracy_in_per_ft is a decimal slope in inches per foot, derived from each manufacturer's stated accuracy and distance (e.g. 3/32 in at 30 ft = 0.09375/30 = 0.003125). range_ft is the unaided line-of-sight working distance, not extended detector range. ip_rating is the IEC code string. accessedAt 2026-06-20. ADVERSARIAL FIX PASS: five accuracy_in_per_ft values were recomputed from primary specs (Bosch GLL3-330CG, Klein 93LCLG, Huepar 603CG, Huepar S04CG, Topcon RL-H5A) where the draft figures were arithmetically wrong; the Topcon figure was off by ~13x. All prices and existence claims were independently confirmed; no products were fabricated.

products.name: Bosch GLL3-330CG 360° Green-Beam Three-Plane Line Laser
products.priceNote: MSRP at launch (Feb 2018 press release); eBay new ~$494 in 2026
products.provenance: Price $499 confirmed from official Bosch press release dated February 14 2018. Accuracy ±3/32" at 30 ft confirmed across Bosch press release and retailer listings; expressed as 0.09375/30 = 0.003125 in/ft (draft's 0.0026 was wrong). Range 200 ft unaided, 330 ft with optional LR8 receiver in pulse mode; IP54, green beam, and 1/4-20 & 5/8-11 threads confirmed on Bosch product page.

products.name: Bosch GLL 55 Self-Leveling Cross-Line Laser
products.priceNote: US MSRP at launch per Bosch press release; current street price ~$159
products.provenance: Launch price $139 USD and September 15 2016 announcement confirmed from Bosch press room. Accuracy ±1/8" at 33 ft confirmed on Bosch product page (0.125/33 = 0.00379). Red beam, range 50 ft, IP54, and 1/4-20 & 5/8-11 threads confirmed on Bosch product page.

products.name: DeWalt DW088K Self-Leveling Cross-Line Laser
products.priceNote: Current street price (Summit Racing and multiple retailers, June 2026; range ~$219-229)
products.provenance: Specs confirmed on DeWalt official product page: red beam, 100 ft unaided (165 ft with detector), ±1/8" at 30 ft (0.125/30 = 0.00417), 1/4-20 mount, IP54. DeWalt does not advertise a dedicated outdoor pulse mode, so pulse_mode_outdoor=false. Price ~$219 corroborated by Summit Racing and other retailers in June 2026. Source URL updated to the live DeWalt en-us product page (legacy /product/ URL redirected).

products.name: Klein Tools 93LCLG Self-Leveling Green Cross-Line Laser with Red Plumb Spots
products.priceNote: Last observed retail price before discontinuation; no longer in production (replaced by 93LCLGR)
products.provenance: Klein Tools product page confirms discontinued status (replacement 93LCLGR recommended). Accuracy ±3/32" per 33 ft for horizontal/vertical beams confirmed on Klein product page; expressed as 0.09375/33 = 0.00284 in/ft (draft's 0.00237 was wrong). Four-beam config (H, V, plumb-up, plumb-down) confirmed, 65 ft outdoor range, IP54, and 1/4"/5/8" threads confirmed. Price $199 per Pro Tool Reviews and resellers; no longer purchasable new from Klein.

products.name: Huepar 603CG 3D Green Beam Self-Leveling Laser Level
products.provenance: Price $119.99 (sale) on Huepar official US store. Accuracy ±1/9" at 33 ft confirmed on Huepar product page; expressed as 0.1111/33 = 0.00337 in/ft (draft's 0.0028 was wrong). Range 130 ft unaided (200 ft with receiver/pulse mode). Green beam, 3×360° planes, IP54, and 1/4-20 & 5/8-11 threads confirmed on Huepar product page. Release ~2018.

products.name: Huepar S04CG 4D Green Beam Self-Leveling Laser Level
products.provenance: Price $236.99 confirmed on Huepar official US store. Specs confirmed on Huepar product page: 4×360° green planes (2 horizontal + 2 vertical, 16 lines), ±1/9" at 33 ft expressed as 0.1111/33 = 0.00337 in/ft (draft's 0.0028 was wrong), self-leveling ±3.5°, IP54, 1/4-20 mount, pulse mode extends range to 200 ft with compatible receiver. Unaided range 66 ft. Release ~2021 (ASIN B08PVLHJWN).

products.name: Johnson Level 40-6543 Self-Leveling Rotary Laser with GreenBrite Technology
products.priceNote: Current retail price (Haus of Tools, authorized dealer)
products.provenance: Price $1,196.95 confirmed at Haus of Tools (authorized dealer). Accuracy ±3/16" per 100 ft confirmed at Haus of Tools; expressed as 0.1875/100 = 0.001875 in/ft (draft's 0.00188 was a correct rounding; tightened to 0.001875). Interior range 400 ft, green GreenBrite beam confirmed. Rotary instruments use a 5/8-11 surveying thread (set per Johnson spec); IP rating not published, left null. pulse_mode_outdoor not specified by manufacturer, left null.

products.name: Spectra Precision LT52G Green Beam Point and Crossline Laser Tool
products.priceNote: Current discounted price (Ohio Power Tool; original list ~$636)
products.provenance: Green beam, 5-point + 2-crossline (7 total) configuration, self-leveling within ±3°, drop-resistant to 3 ft confirmed across resellers. products.name: Leica Lino L2 Cross-Line Laser
products.priceNote: Current price at Global Test Supply

products.name: Topcon RL-H5A Self-Leveling Horizontal Rotary Laser
products.priceNote: Laser-only price (Geo Networking SKU 500-30146); kit bundles with receiver run higher
